rubrics.dependency: Normalize group and parent earnings, average economic capital and margins; qualify cost of capital. Group ROE alone is insufficient.
Qualify ACB-specific customer advantage, pricing behavior and persistence; statements do not establish a moat.
Reconcile accrued interest, interest collected, restructured loans, provisions and exceptional income; bank CFO/NPAT is prohibited as cash-quality substitute.
Qualify ACB deposit/borrower concentration, pricing response and cycle/stress evidence beyond reported balances.
Qualify loan-group migrations, NPL and restructured exposures, reserve denominator, deposit concentration and regulatory framework exclusions. Reported CAR is not full-topic acceptance.
Map ACB contractual maturity gaps, callable/unrestricted liquidity, funding concentration, covenants and contingent obligations.
Specify deposit runoff, credit-loss and capital/funding response scenarios and qualify resulting constraints; no invented stress assumptions.
Reconcile corporate actions, dilution, acquisitions/base effects and normalized parent earnings before per-share growth assessment.
Qualify lending/deposit runway, reinvestment, capital constraints and execution; historical loan growth is not a forecast.
Identify incremental capital and recurring parent profit with a compatible lag/denominator and unit economics.
Qualify banking entry barriers, competition, demand and digital/regulatory disruption under approved source authority.
Qualify ACB market share, funding cost position and distribution economics; no market-share inference from balance-sheet size.
Qualify dated banking cycle evidence, forward loss/funding asymmetry and ACB survivability.
Owner-approved valuation cutoff/source policy, action-adjusted shares/price, normalized common-owner earnings/book capital, economic assumptions and independent crosscheck.
Approved starting price/value, dilution/action history, distributions, exit value, growth and scenario assumptions.
Approved conservative intrinsic value and downside stress with compatible price/share cutoff and loss/capital evidence.
Qualify ACB disclosure quality, related-party terms, minority protections and auditor findings; audited status alone is insufficient.
Qualify residual credit/funding/operational channels and mitigations, with explicit overlap control; ratio proxies alone cannot rate risk.
Qualify common-earnings forecast ranges, sensitivity and regulatory/source dependencies before judging uncertainty.
Map ACB investment/acquisition/divestment decisions and subsequent economic outcomes; industrial capex proxy is inapplicable.
Qualify retention/distribution/buyback decisions against capital resilience and contemporaneous valuation; no assumed buyback value.
Qualify actual issue terms, proceeds deployment and adjusted per-share outcomes across all corporate actions.
Reconstruct action-adjusted common-owner per-share value over a cycle; no shares inferred from EPS or group NPAT.
